contextconfig.title: Webcrawler Site Context
contextconfig.description: Contextual information for crawling a website

$schema.description: A pointer to (this) schema file used to validate/govern the format of the context file.

name.description: The unique name of the context

headers.description: Include any key-value pairs to be included in the request header submission when requesting content in this context.

base.description: The base-url that defines the scope of the site or repository. Used to map new links to appropriate contexts and to define site-boundaries.

refresh.description: A description of the refresh-frequency after which a page will be reconsidered for refresh. Set to null for no auto-refresh logic.
